_fixture: Known-good cohort for the Friday demo: residents' approved snapshots and manually reviewed connections, in the v1.1 contract. Arjun has not approved or shared, so he must not appear in the graph.

snapshots.name: Meera
snapshots.intent: Finish thirty interviews on how farming families borrow money, and turn them into a public report.
snapshots.problem: Small farmers borrow from informal lenders at steep rates, and banks never see how families actually decide.
snapshots.current_frontier: How do I get families to talk honestly about debt in a single visit?

snapshots.name: Kabir
snapshots.intent: Get three working sensor prototypes into village water tanks and log a month of readings.
snapshots.problem: Village tanks run dry without warning, and the people who manage them have no cheap way to see the level.
snapshots.current_frontier: Can a sensor survive monsoon humidity and still cost under five hundred rupees?

snapshots.name: Ananya
snapshots.intent: Draft four chapters of a book about the old markets of Pune.
snapshots.problem: The people who run Pune's old markets are disappearing as the markets modernise, and nobody is recording their stories.
snapshots.current_frontier: How do I shape the book so it isn't just a list of portraits?

snapshots.name: Dev
snapshots.intent: Run an AI tutor pilot in two government school classrooms.
snapshots.problem: Teachers in government schools have fifty students and no time for one-to-one help, and most learning apps assume a phone per child.
snapshots.current_frontier: How do I measure whether students actually learned, not just used it?

snapshots.name: Zoya
snapshots.intent: Shoot and rough-cut a fifteen-minute documentary on the last letter-writers of the old city.
snapshots.problem: The last professional letter-writers are retiring, and their trade and its stories will be lost within a few years.
snapshots.current_frontier: How do I earn the trust of people who have never been filmed?

snapshots.name: Arjun
snapshots.intent: Put every weekly market in three small towns on an open map.
snapshots.problem: Small towns are missing from the maps people use, so their markets and services are invisible.

connections.why_connected: You're both working out how to get honest answers from people who are rarely asked.
connections.what_to_explore: What do you each do in the first ten minutes to make someone comfortable?
